name: pricetime
description: PriceTime — Multi-crypto paper trading exchange with BST/DLL matching, circular lists, stacks, sorting algorithms, FIFO P&L, TradingView charts, and Neon Postgres (Demo funds only)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w @pricetime/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pricetime/api && npm run build -w @pricetime/web
